# general setting
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(mgcv)
library(broom.mixed)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(patchwork)
library(here)
library(naniar)
library(janitor)
library(skimr)
library(gtsummary)
library(cmdstanr)
library(bayesplot)
library(posterior) # trace plot
library(loo)
```



```{r}
# data import, rename and recode some variables
data <- read.csv(here("Project_1","Data", "hiv_6624_final.csv")) %>% clean_names() %>%
  filter(years %in% c(0,2)) %>%
  group_by(newid) %>%
  filter(all(c(0,2) %in% years)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    years,
    id = newid,
    drugs = ifelse(hard_drugs == 0, "No", "Yes"),
    vload,
    log10_vload = log10(vload),
    leu3n = ifelse(leu3n < 0, NA_real_, leu3n),
    phys = agg_phys,
    ment = agg_ment,
    age,
    race = case_when(
      race == 1 ~ "Non-Hispanic White",
      race %in% c(2,3,4,5,6,7,8) ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    edu = case_when(
      educbas %in% c(1,2,3,4) ~ "No college degree or lower",
      educbas %in% c(5,6,7) ~ "College or higher",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    bmi = case_when(
      bmi == -1 | bmi > 100 ~ NA_character_,
      bmi < 18.5 ~ "Underweight",
      bmi >= 18.5 & bmi <= 24.9 ~ "Normal",
      bmi > 24.9 ~ "Overweight",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    adherence = case_when(
      adh == 1 ~ "100%",
      adh == 2 ~ "95-99%",
      adh == 3 ~ "75-94%",
      adh == 4 ~ "<75%",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    smoke = case_when(
      smoke %in% c(1,2) ~ "Non-current",
      smoke == 3 ~ "Current smoker",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
  )

#  pivot wider
data_wide <- data %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = id,
    names_from = years,
    values_from = c(log10_vload, leu3n, phys, ment,
                    drugs, age, race, edu,
                    bmi, adherence, smoke))
# outcome we use
data_wide <- data_wide %>%
  mutate(
    log10_vload_change = log10_vload_2 - log10_vload_0,
    leu3n_change = leu3n_2 - leu3n_0,
    phys_change = phys_2 - phys_0,
    ment_change = ment_2 - ment_0)

```



# missingness check
```{r}
outcomes <- c("log10_vload_change","leu3n_change","phys_change","ment_change")
predictors <- c("drugs_0","age_0","race_0","edu_0","bmi_0",
                "adherence_2","smoke_0")

vars <- c(outcomes, predictors)

missing_summary <- data_wide %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      all_of(vars),
      list(
        missing_n   = ~ sum(is.na(.)),
        missing_pct = ~ mean(is.na(.))
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = c("variable", ".value"),
    names_sep = "_missing_"
  )

print(missing_summary)
```

```{r}
# sample size check
all_vars <- c(outcomes, predictors)
n_complete_all <- sum(complete.cases(data_wide[, all_vars]))
n_complete_all
```

```{r}
data_final <- data_wide %>%
  filter(complete.cases(across(all_vars)))
```



# range check
```{r}
range_check <- data_final %>%
  summarise(across(c(log10_vload_0, log10_vload_2, leu3n_0, leu3n_2,phys_0, phys_2, ment_0, ment_2,log10_vload_change, leu3n_change,phys_change, ment_change, age_0),
                   list(min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
                        max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable_stat",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stat = ifelse(grepl("_min$", variable_stat), "min", "max"),
    variable = sub("_(min|max)$", "", variable_stat)
  ) %>%
  select(variable, stat, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = stat,
    values_from = value
  )

print(range_check)
```

```{r}
outcomes <- c("log10_vload_change","leu3n_change","phys_change","ment_change")
outcome_labels <- c(
  "log10_vload_change" = "log10(Viral Load) Change",
  "leu3n_change" = "CD4+ T Cell Count Change",
  "phys_change" = "Aggregate Physical QoL Score Change",
  "ment_change" = "Aggregate Mental QoL Score Change"
)

plots <- lapply(outcomes, function(var){
  ggplot(data_final, aes_string(x = var)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#2c7fb8", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = outcome_labels[var], x = "Change (2y - baseline)", y = "Count")
})

combined_plot <- (plots[[1]] | plots[[2]]) / (plots[[3]] | plots[[4]])

print(combined_plot)
ggsave(filename = here("Project_1","Report","outcome_hist_2x2.png"),
       plot = combined_plot, width = 10, height = 8)
```

# Table 1
```{r}
var_labels <- list(
  age_0 = "Age (years)",
  race_0 = "Race/Ethnicity",
  edu_0 = "Education",
  bmi_0 = "BMI category",
  smoke_0 = "Smoking",
  adherence_2 = "Adherence to Treatment at Year 2",
  log10_vload_change = "Change in log10 Viral Load",
  leu3n_change = "Change in CD4 count",
  phys_change = "Change in Physical Health",
  ment_change = "Change in Mental Health"
)

table1 <- data_final %>%
  select(drugs_0, age_0, race_0, edu_0, bmi_0,
         smoke_0, adherence_2,
         log10_vload_change, leu3n_change, phys_change, ment_change) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = drugs_0,
    label = var_labels,
    missing = "ifany",
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    type = list(
      age_0 ~ "continuous",
      log10_vload_change ~ "continuous",
      leu3n_change ~ "continuous",
      phys_change ~ "continuous",
      ment_change ~ "continuous"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_overall(last = TRUE) %>%
  bold_labels()

table1
```

```{r}

    bmi_overweight  = ifelse(bmi_0 == "Overweight", 1, 0),
    bmi_underweight = ifelse(bmi_0 == "Underweight", 1, 0),
    adherence_95   = ifelse(adherence_2 == "95-99%", 1, 0),
```

# Stan model template
```{r}
# These are the data for all 8 models
# stan_data_vload_adh
# stan_data_vload
# stan_data_leu3n_adh
# stan_data_leu3n
# stan_data_phys_adh
# stan_data_phys
# stan_data_ment_adh
# stan_data_ment

# These are the two stan:
# linear_adh_model
# linear_model

fit_stan_adh <- linear_adh_model$sample(
  data = stan_data_vload_adh,
  seed = 648,
  chains = 4,
  iter_warmup = 2000,
  iter_sampling = 10000,
  parallel_chains = 4
)

fit_stan_adh$summary()
```

```{r}
posterior_matrix <- fit_stan_adh$draws(format = "matrix")
posterior_matrix_params <- posterior_matrix[, !colnames(posterior_matrix) %in% "lp__"]
mcmc_intervals(posterior_matrix_params, prob = 0.95)
```
```{r}
posterior <- as_draws_array(fit_stan_adh$draws())
mcmc_trace(posterior, pars = c("beta_drugs_0"))
```
